title: Introduce staged probe fingerprinter and humanized changelog builder
author: Priya Kumar
description:
Motivation: onboarding teams asked for a more deterministic way to surface sample-level evidence for perf regressions and to produce changelogs that read like release notes (human summaries + evidence pointers). This PR introduces a staged probe fingerprinter that computes stable, compact fingerprints for sampled telemetry slices and stitches those fingerprints into the onboarding manifest. It also adds a second-generation changelog builder that groups changes by impact class (latency/cost/accuracy), attaches representative probe fingerprints, and generates human-friendly prose snippets for release notes.

What this changes (high level): 1) New ingest component (staged fingerprinter) integrated into intake pipeline; 2) Backfill script to generate fingerprints for recent manifests; 3) Changelog builder v2 that consumes fingerprints and probe summaries to synthesize release snippets; 4) Tests + small additions to the onboarding manifest schema to store fingerprint metadata (stable seed, hash version, sample window).

Design notes: the fingerprinter uses a deterministic hashing pipeline (stable-seed + canonicalized probe vector) and a configurable LSH step to keep the artifact compact. Fingerprints are stable across identical sample windows and reproducible across runs (unless the seed or hash version changes). The changelog builder applies heuristics to surface the most representative probe for each performance delta (prefers median-latency sample that shows the delta).

Backward compatibility & opt-out: new manifest fields are additive; we added an onboarding flag `fingerprint_enabled` with default true. For very large onboarding batches customers can opt out at ingestion time. The backfill tool has a `--dry-run` mode and an idempotent write path.

Testing & CI: unit tests for the hash pipeline and integration harness that runs on a small sampled dataset. CI initially flagged a flaky integration test (timeout when running the LSH indexer on the small in-memory dataset); I reduced memory allocation and added a tight timeout in test harness. CI now passes.

Migration/rollout: staged rollout — deploy fingerprinter behind a feature flag, run backfill for the last 90 days, point the changelog builder at the new artifact store. Docs updated with a migration section and example CLI commands.

Checklist:
- [x] Fingerprinter implementation (src/ingest/fingerprinter.py)
- [x] Changelog builder + template (tools/changelog/builder_v2.py)
- [x] Backfill script + dry-run (scripts/backfill_fingerprints.py)
- [x] Manifest schema additions and defaulting (schema/onboard_manifest_v2.json)
- [x] Unit + integration tests (tests/test_fingerprinter.py, tests/test_changelog_builder.py)
- [x] Docs and migration guide (docs/onboarding/fingerprints.md)

review_comments: Liam O'Rourke: Can we avoid inflating the manifest with large sample blobs? Recommend storing only pointers to the probe blob and keeping fingerprint small (max 256 bytes).
Priya Kumar (author): Updated to store pointer + compact 128-bit fingerprint, added pointer-only backfill option.
Sofia Martinez: Add a feature-flag gate for rollout (we need to be able to disable quickly during a problematic backfill).
Priya Kumar (author): Added `fingerprint_enabled` gate and an admin toggle in the console config; updated docs and tests.
Abe Rosenthal: The changelog prose generator feels a bit too chatty for enterprise release notes. Can we add a `style=concise|detailed` option?
Priya Kumar (author): Added a `style` arg (defaults to concise) and a short unit test for the concise path.
SRE (infra): The backfill script caused a transient spike during a dry run in staging; please add a rate limiter for store writes.
Priya Kumar (author): Added token-bucket rate limiter and an environment variable to tune throughput; reran backfill in staging successfully.
release_notes: Add staged probe fingerprinter and humanized changelog builder: deterministic probe fingerprints are stored in onboard manifests to provide reproducible evidence for performance deltas. Changelog builder v2 synthesizes grouped, human-readable release snippets with representative probe pointers. Migration: backfill tool available for recent manifests; rollout behind a feature flag.
